paragraphs.title: Israel’s Defeat and the Death of Saul and His Sons

easy.explanation: The Israelites fell slain on Mount Gilboa.
easy.q: Where did the men of Israel fall slain?

easy.explanation: The Philistines slew Jonathan, Abinadab, and Melchi-shua.
easy.q: Which sons of Saul were slain by the Philistines?

easy.explanation: Saul took a sword and fell upon it.

medium.explanation: Saul feared that the uncircumcised Philistines would abuse him.
medium.q: Why did Saul ask his armourbearer to thrust him through?

medium.explanation: The archers struck Saul with arrows.
medium.q: What does “the archers hit him” mean?

medium.explanation: Saul then took a sword and fell upon it.
medium.q: What happened after Saul’s armourbearer refused to kill him?

answers: He wanted to join the Philistines
challenge.explanation: The armourbearer would not do it because he was sore afraid.
challenge.q: Why did Saul’s armourbearer refuse to kill him?

answers: His three sons, his armourbearer, and all his men
challenge.explanation: Saul, his three sons, his armourbearer, and all his men died together.
challenge.q: Who died with Saul that same day?

challenge.explanation: When he saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise upon his sword.

paragraphs.title: The Abandonment of the Towns and Philistine Control

answers: Israel had fled and Saul and his sons were dead
easy.explanation: They saw that Israel had fled and Saul and his sons were dead.
easy.q: What did the Israelites on the other side of the valley and Jordan see?

answers: They forsook the cities and fled
easy.explanation: The inhabitants abandoned their cities and fled.
easy.q: What did the inhabitants of the cities do?

easy.explanation: The Philistines came and dwelt in the cities.
easy.q: Who dwelt in the cities afterward?

medium.explanation: They saw that Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons were dead.
medium.q: What caused the inhabitants to flee?

answers: The Philistines settled first, then Israel fled
Israel fled, the inhabitants fled, and the Philistines occupied the cities
The inhabitants fled, Israel won, and the Philistines retreated
medium.explanation: This is the sequence given in the verse.
medium.q: What was the correct order of events?

answers: The Philistines came and dwelt in them
medium.explanation: The Philistines came and occupied the cities.
medium.q: What was the result of the cities being abandoned?

challenge.explanation: The flight and loss of the cities show Israel’s defeat.
challenge.q: What does the abandonment of the cities show about Israel’s condition?

answers: Saul’s death made the people stay
The news of his death helped cause the people to flee
His death caused Jabesh-gilead to leave
challenge.explanation: The people fled after seeing that Saul and his sons were dead.
challenge.q: How were Saul’s death and the Philistines’ occupation connected?

answers: The Philistines left and Israel entered
The inhabitants left and the Philistines entered
challenge.explanation: The inhabitants fled, and the Philistines came and dwelt in the cities.
challenge.q: Who left the cities, and who entered them?

paragraphs.title: Saul’s Humiliation and the Philistine Display of Victory

easy.explanation: They found them on the morrow.
easy.q: When did the Philistines find Saul and his sons?
What did the Philistines do to Saul’s head?

easy.explanation: They put his armour in the house of Ashtaroth.
easy.q: Where did they put Saul’s armour?

answers: They put the armour in Ashtaroth’s house and fastened his body to Beth-shan’s wall
medium.explanation: The armour was placed in Ashtaroth’s house, and the body was fastened to the wall of Beth-shan.
medium.q: What did the Philistines do with Saul’s armour and body?

answers: To announce the victory in their idol temple
medium.explanation: They sent the news to the house of their idols to proclaim their victory.
medium.q: What does “to publish it in the house of their idols” mean?

medium.explanation: They published the news among the people as a victory announcement.
medium.q: Why did the Philistines send the news throughout their land?

challenge.explanation: The display publicly proclaimed the Philistines’ victory.
challenge.q: What was the purpose of displaying Saul’s armour and body?

answers: The armour was put in Ashtaroth’s house, and the body was fastened to Beth-shan’s wall
The armour was buried, and the body was sent to Philistia
The armour was burned, and the body was returned to Israel
challenge.explanation: The passage gives these two different locations.
challenge.q: What distinction does the passage make between Saul’s armour and his body?

answers: To their idols and the people
challenge.explanation: The Philistines published it in the house of their idols and among the people.
challenge.q: To whom was the news sent?

paragraphs.title: The Men of Jabesh-gilead Restore Saul’s Honor

easy.explanation: The inhabitants of Jabesh-gilead heard about it.
easy.q: Who heard what the Philistines had done to Saul?

easy.explanation: The valiant men arose and went all night.
easy.q: When did the valiant men leave Jabesh-gilead?

medium.explanation: They honored Saul by recovering and burying his body.
medium.q: Why did the men of Jabesh-gilead recover Saul’s body?

answers: They displayed them on the wall
medium.explanation: They brought the bodies to Jabesh and burnt them there.
medium.q: What did they do after bringing the bodies to Jabesh?

answers: They took the bones and buried them
They returned the bodies to Beth-shan
medium.explanation: They took the bones and buried them under a tree at Jabesh.
medium.q: What did they do after the burning?

answers: The Philistines dishonored Saul, but Jabesh-gilead cared for his burial
The Philistines buried Saul, but Jabesh-gilead destroyed the cities
The Philistines saved Saul’s sons, but Jabesh-gilead fled
challenge.explanation: The Philistines displayed Saul dishonorably, while Jabesh-gilead recovered and buried him.
challenge.q: How did the men of Jabesh-gilead act differently from the Philistines?

answers: Their uncertainty about the bodies’ location
Their desire to hide from Israel
challenge.explanation: Going all night shows their determination to recover the bodies.
challenge.q: What does their journey through the night show?

answers: Burial, burning, collecting bones, and fasting
Recovering the bodies, burning them, burying the bones, and fasting
Fasting, displaying the bodies, burning, and fleeing
challenge.explanation: This is the order described in verses 12–13.
challenge.q: What was the sequence of their actions?
